forum.title: May I ask, is there any design clue for this oval loading
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @DreamLovely.

You can quite easily create a custom widget for this by using two Circle widgets and two Line widgets, as illustrated below:

![JohanAstrup_0-1778833239744.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a2c43bf2-f2df-b612-5a62-8c5272aa4fbf.png "JohanAstrup_0-1778833239744.png")

Let me know if that makes sense. Otherwise I can create a small example.

Best regards,

Johan
